# simplelogin_mailbox (Data Source)

Looks up a SimpleLogin mailbox (a forwarding destination) by its email address. Use its `id` in `simplelogin_alias.mailbox_ids`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplelogin_mailbox" "primary" {
  email = "personal@example.net"
}

output "primary_mailbox_id" {
  value = data.simplelogin_mailbox.primary.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Mailbox email address (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the account's default mailbox.
- `id` (Number) SimpleLogin mailbox ID.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the mailbox is verified. Only verified mailboxes can receive aliases.
